activity.demoTranscript:
[00:00] Salesperson: Good morning, this is Jan Nowak from CRMtree. Could I speak to the person responsible for business travel?

[00:08] Customer: Yes, speaking. This is Marek Kowalski.

[00:10] Salesperson: Good morning, Mr. Kowalski. I am calling about optimizing business travel costs at your company. Do you have a moment?

[00:18] Customer: Yes, go ahead. What exactly are you proposing?

[00:22] Salesperson: We offer a complete corporate travel management system — flight, hotel and transport bookings in one place. On average, our customers save between 15 and 25% on travel costs.

[00:35] Customer: Sounds interesting. How many people need to travel per year for it to make sense?

[00:40] Salesperson: Our platform pays off from just a few dozen trips a year. I can prepare an individual calculation for your company.

[00:49] Customer: All right. Please send the offer by email. Our team will review it.

[00:54] Salesperson: Of course, I will send it today. Could we also schedule a short online presentation to show the system in action?

[01:02] Customer: Yes, we can. I will suggest a date once we have reviewed the offer.

[01:06] Salesperson: Great. Thank you for your time, speak soon.

[01:09] Customer: Goodbye.
